{{1956 Nebraska College Conference football standings}}
The '''1956 Kearney State Antelopes football team''' was an [[American football]] team that represented Kearney State Teachers College (later renamed [[University of Nebraska at Kearney]]) as a member of the [[Nebraska College Conference]] (NCC) during the [[1956 NAIA football season]]. In their second season under head coach [[Allen H. Zikmund]], the Antelopes compiled a perfect 9–0 record (7–0 against NCC opponents), won the NCC championship, and outscored opponents by a total of 255 to 66.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nebraska-Kearney Yearly Results|publisher=[[College Football Data Warehouse]]|accessdate=May 13, 2023|url=http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/n/nebraska_kearney/1955-1959_yearly_results.php|archive-date=September 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906203232/http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/n/nebraska_kearney/1955-1959_yearly_results.php|url-status=dead}}</ref>

The 1956 season was one of four [[perfect season]]s in the history of the Kearney football program, along with the [[1941 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1941]], [[1958 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1958]], and [[1967 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1967 seasons]].
